preview.tournamentOverview: Detroit Golf Club rewards ball-striking over putting, with SG OTT (26.8%) and SG APP (21.3%) carrying the heaviest course weights. The field will play a par-72 layout that punishes missed fairways and approaches, making driving accuracy and approach play decisive. The Rocket Classic sits in the PGA Tour's early-summer swing and offers a last tune-up before the U.S. Open.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model tilts heavily toward off-the-tee and approach metrics, combining SG OTT (26.8%) and SG APP (21.3%) for nearly half the total weight. SG Total (22.8%) provides a broad baseline, while SG ATG (10.6%) and SG PUTT (8.4%) receive lighter emphasis given the course's bias against scrambling and putting. Driving accuracy (4.1%) and bogey avoidance (3.0%) round out the profile, ensuring the model prioritizes players who keep the ball in play and hit greens from the fairway.
preview.pickApproach: We tier players by blending tournament-specific rank with overall power rank, favoring those who post strong SG OTT and SG APP numbers at Detroit's weights. Tier-one bets target the top eight on the model board who also sit inside the top-15 power rankings. Tier-two exposure looks at mid-tier names whose course fit (high SG APP or SG PUTT) outpaces their weaker power rank, while fading anyone whose profile is skewed toward putting or around-the-green play.

article.title: Rocket Classic 2026: Model Ranks Lead Picks at Detroit
article.dek: Tournament model ranks Cameron Young #1, Si Woo Kim #2, and Jake Knapp #3 ahead of the 141-player field at Detroit Golf Club.
article.introduction: The Rocket Classic model places heavy emphasis on SG OTT (26.8%) and SG APP (21.3%), with SG Total weighted at 22.8%. Cameron Young leads the model at rank #1 with 1.574 SG Total, while Si Woo Kim sits at #2 with 1.236 SG Total. The 141-player field tees off July 30 at Detroit Golf Club.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The Rocket Classic model weights SG OTT at 26.8%, SG APP at 21.3%, and SG Total at 22.8%. Cameron Young leads at model rank #1 with 1.574 SG Total, followed by Si Woo Kim at #2 with 1.236 SG Total and Jake Knapp at #3 with 2.002 SG Total.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Detroit Golf Club places the highest weight on SG OTT (26.8%) and SG APP (21.3%). Cameron Young leads the model with 0.699 SG OTT, while Nicolai Højgaard ranks #8 with 0.712 SG APP. Players with negative SG OTT marks like Hideki Matsuyama (-0.099) face a steeper climb against the course weights.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: Cameron Young enters at model rank #1 with 1.574 SG Total and 0.699 SG OTT. Si Woo Kim sits at model rank #2 with 1.236 SG Total. Russell Henley ranks #11 with 1.186 SG Total, while Jordan Smith ranks #17 with 0.465 SG Total.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: Si Woo Kim, Russell Henley, Hideki Matsuyama, Jordan Smith, Ryan Gerard, Cameron Young, Xander Schauffele, Patrick Cantlay, and Rickie Fowler each carry four tracked rounds. Nicolai Højgaard and Akshay Bhatia logged two tracked rounds, while David Lipsky has zero tracked rounds.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Cameron Young sits at FedExCup rank #3, Si Woo Kim at #7, and Ryan Gerard at #18. Russell Henley ranks #14, Nicolai Højgaard #30, and Hideki Matsuyama #26. Jordan Smith sits at FedExCup rank #67, while David Lipsky is at #78.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Cameron Young, Si Woo Kim, and Xander Schauffele each skipped the Scottish Open and rank inside the top-10 model ranks. Jordan Smith, Russell Henley, Ryan Gerard, Patrick Cantlay, and Rickie Fowler all show tournament model ranks well ahead of their power ranks. Nicolai Højgaard and Akshay Bhatia both missed the Open cut and carry limited tracked reps.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Si Woo Kim (model rank #2) leads outright targets with 1.236 SG Total but carries -0.39 SG PUTT, the weakest putting mark among the top-5 model ranks. Nicolai Højgaard (model rank #8) posted 1.568 SG Total but missed the Open cut and logged six tracked rounds. Russell Henley (model rank #11) sits at 1.186 SG Total with 0.313 SG APP, the lowest approach mark among the top-12 model ranks. Hideki Matsuyama (model rank #14) posted 1.197 SG Total but carries -0.099 SG OTT, the lowest off-the-tee mark among the top-15 model ranks. Jordan Smith (model rank #17) posted 0.465 SG Total with -0.275 SG PUTT among the weakest putting marks in the top-20 model ranks.

sections.heading: Top-5 Targets
sections.body: Si Woo Kim (model rank #2) and Nicolai Højgaard (model rank #8) lead top-5 targets. Russell Henley (model rank #11) and Hideki Matsuyama (model rank #14) follow. Ryan Gerard (model rank #12) posted 0.94 SG Total with -0.276 SG ATG, the lowest around-the-green mark among the top-15 model ranks.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: Cameron Young (model rank #1) leads top-10 targets with 1.574 SG Total. Si Woo Kim (model rank #2) and Xander Schauffele (model rank #5) follow. Nicolai Højgaard (model rank #8) and Akshay Bhatia (model rank #9) round out the tier. Akshay Bhatia posted -0.044 SG OTT, weak versus the 26.8% OTT weight.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: Russell Henley (model rank #11), Ryan Gerard (model rank #12), and Hideki Matsuyama (model rank #14) anchor top-20 targets. Patrick Cantlay (model rank #16) posted 0.146 SG APP, low versus the 21.3% APP weight. Rickie Fowler (model rank #20) posted -0.318 SG ATG, poor versus the 10.6% ATG weight. David Lipsky (model rank #21) posted 0.192 SG APP, weak versus the 21.3% APP weight.

sections.heading: Data Limitations
sections.body: Weather and tee-time data are not available in this pipeline; the article does not make weather- or tee-time-specific claims. Workload coverage includes only recorded rounds from The Open Championship and Genesis Scottish Open. Opposite-field, DP World Tour, LIV, and other events may be missing, so 'No tracked rounds' does not necessarily mean the player rested.

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Strong model-supported bets: Cameron Young (model rank #1), Si Woo Kim (model rank #2), Nicolai Højgaard (model rank #8). Secondary value plays: Russell Henley (model rank #11), Ryan Gerard (model rank #12), Hideki Matsuyama (model rank #14). Speculative long shots: Jordan Smith (model rank #17), Patrick Cantlay (model rank #16), Rickie Fowler (model rank #20), David Lipsky (model rank #21).

article.conclusion: Strong model-supported bets: Cameron Young (model rank #1), Si Woo Kim (model rank #2), Nicolai Højgaard (model rank #8). Secondary value plays: Russell Henley (model rank #11), Ryan Gerard (model rank #12), Hideki Matsuyama (model rank #14). Speculative long shots: Jordan Smith (model rank #17), Patrick Cantlay (model rank #16), Rickie Fowler (model rank #20), David Lipsky (model rank #21).

Si Woo Kim ranks #2 in the model with 1.236 SG Total and 0.572 SG OTT, yet his -0.39 SG PUTT is the weakest putting mark among the top-5 model ranks.
Nicolai Højgaard sits at model rank #8 with 1.568 SG Total and 0.712 SG APP, but missed the cut at The Open and carries a six-round workload.
Russell Henley ranks #11 in the model with 1.186 SG Total, but his 0.313 SG APP is the lowest approach mark among the top-12 model ranks.
Jordan Smith ranks #17 in the model with 0.465 SG Total, well ahead of his power rank #59, and carries four tracked rounds post-Open.
